config.fence: F = P prefilter at list epoch e0, then one policy call over the <=5 IDs about to be returned; fast path returns IDs unchanged when the authority epoch still equals e0; if the fence drops any ID, rerun P once with a fresh list and fence again
config.race: victim = query top eligible document under the base 10% random revocation; a revoker thread commits base+victim at start+U, U~Uniform[0,horizon]; authority restored after each trial; index flags never change
config.exposure: victim returned and authority commit_ns < client end_ns (request-end freshness); stale base exposure scored separately
config.wait: policy response wait after the authority snapshot, once per HTTP call; not a WAN model
